nodes_update.name: A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
nodes_update.note: Born Abhay Charan De, Calcutta, 1 September 1896; initiated by Bhaktisiddhanta 1933; sannyasa 1959; Jaladuta to Boston 1965; founded ISKCON, New York, July 1966; Bhagavad-gita As It Is (1968/1972); died Vrindavan 14 November 1977

edges_upsert.note: Gaudiya Vaishnava teacher in the Chaitanya line; the parampara printed in Bhagavad-gita As It Is runs from Krishna through Madhva and Chaitanya; the Madhva link and the shiksha links (Bhaktivinoda, Bhaktisiddhanta) are debated (Rosen 1994 notes debate among Madhva-tradition scholars) and hereditary Gaudiya lines
First met 1922 in Calcutta (introduced by Narendranath Mullik); initiated at Allahabad 1933 as Abhay Charanaravinda; letter of 3 December 1936 urging him to preach in English
Bhaktivinoda's writings and programme of English-language Gaudiya preaching, transmitted through Bhaktisiddhanta; listed in Prabhupada's parampara
Sannyasa initiation, Keshavji Gaudiya Math, Mathura, 17 September 1959
Disciple of Bhaktisiddhanta; year of initiation not checked
Narayana Maharaja and his followers describe a close shiksha relationship; the GBC published a paper disputing its extent
Produced the 1969 Hare Krishna mantra single; donated Bhaktivedanta Manor 1973

glossary.def: Inconceivable simultaneous oneness and difference: the Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, systematised by Jiva Goswami, that souls and the world are one with God in quality and different from him in power, in a way beyond full understanding.

The great mantra: the sixteen-word Hare Krishna chant (Hare Krishna Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna Hare Hare, Hare Rama Hare Rama, Rama Rama Hare Hare), the central practice of Chaitanya's followers and ISKCON.
Congregational chanting of God's names, often in public with drums and cymbals; in ISKCON the word also covers book distribution as a form of preaching.
The third traditional stage of life, after student and householder, in which a person withdraws from family affairs before full renunciation.

Originally a Vedic officiating priest; in ISKCON, a representative who performs initiation on the guru's behalf. The ritvik movement holds that Prabhupada remains the initiating guru of all later members.
The guru's household: a traditional residential school where pupils live with their teacher. ISKCON's boarding schools used the name.
Doctrine of illusion: the name Vaishnava critics give to Advaita Vedanta, which they read as making the personal God and the individual soul finally unreal.
Instruction. A shiksha guru teaches and guides without necessarily giving formal initiation (diksha).

prabhupada: Born Abhay Charan De 1 Sep 1896 Calcutta, day after Janmashtami; parents Gour Mohan De and Rajani De; Suvarna Banik -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A._C._Bhaktivedanta_Swami_Prabhupada
Scottish Church College 1916-1920; refused diploma; married Radharani Datta 1918, five children; pharmaceutical business in Allahabad -> same

Met Bhaktisiddhanta 1922 via Narendranath Mullik; initiated Allahabad 1933 as Abhay Charanaravinda; title Bhaktivedanta 1939; Back to Godhead 1944; vanaprastha 1950; League of Devotees Jhansi 1952; sannyasa 17 Sep 1959 Keshavji Gaudiya Math Mathura from Bhakti Prajnan Keshava -> same

Jaladuta departed Calcutta 13 Aug 1965, arrived Boston 17 Sep 1965; two heart attacks; ~40 rupees and 200 sets of first canto; Agarwal family Butler PA -> same; https://vanipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_Srila_Prabhupada's_Life_-_1965

ISKCON incorporated July 1966; Mantra-Rock Dance Avalon Ballroom 1967 with Grateful Dead, ~3,000; GBC 1970; >100 temples; >80 books; died 14 Nov 1977 Krishna Balaram Mandir after long illness; 11 disciples appointed to initiate on his behalf -> Wikipedia
Tompkins Square Park chanting 9 Oct 1966 -> https://evgrieve.com/2015/10/49-years-ago-today-hare-krishna.html (title)

Quote 'I have every hope that you can turn yourself [into] a very good English preacher', letter of 3 Dec 1936; Bhaktisiddhanta died 1 Jan 1937, no successor, split; self-sannyasa 1918 before picture of Gaurakishora; initiation from Gaurakishora 1900 or Jan 1901 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhaktisiddhanta_Sarasvati

Letter of 9 July 1977 sent by Tamal Krishna Goswami naming eleven; zonal acharyas 1978-82 with vyasasanas and daily worship; Jayatirtha left 1982 and expelled; reform led by Ravindra Svarupa from 1984 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISKCON_guru_system; https://vedabase.io/en/library/letters/letter-to-all-gbc-all-temple-presidents/

Kirtanananda expelled 16 March 1987; indicted 1990 (racketeering, mail fraud, conspiracy to murder Bryant and St. Denis); convicted 29 March 1991 on 9 of 11, hung on murder; convictions overturned on appeal; 1996 guilty plea to one racketeering count, 20 years; released 2004; died 2011 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kirtanananda_Swami

Supreme Court 16 May 2025 (Oka, Masih JJ) set aside Karnataka HC order, temple belongs to ISKCON Bangalore; review split Nov 2025; fresh bench sought Aug 2026 -> https://www.verdictum.in/amp/supreme-court/plea-on-bengaluru-iskcon-temples-verdict-review-1620014

ISKCON response: property not ritvik; HC 2011; quote 'we will be exploring all available legal remedies' (Yudhistir Govinda Das) -> https://iskconnews.org/iskcon-responds-to-indias-supreme-court-decision/

Rochford with Heinlein, ISKCON Communications Journal 6:1 June 1998; schools Dallas (1971-76), LA, New Vrindaban, Seattle, Vrindavan; quote 'no one knows how many of ISKCON's children were abused' -> https://www.iskconcommunications.org/iskcon-journal/vol-6/child-abuse-in-the-hare-krishna-movement-1971-1986

Suit filed Dallas federal court by Windle Turley, 44 plaintiffs, defendants ISKCON, 17 GBC members, Prabhupada's estate -> https://www.beliefnet.com/news/2000/06/hare-krishna-group-sued-for-alleged-child-abuse.aspx

$400 million; filed 12 June 2000; federal claims dismissed 2001, refiled Texas state court Oct 2001; 11 entities Chapter 11 in CA and WV 2002; plans confirmed May 2005 -> https://surrealist.org/gurukula/timeline/lawsuitdocs.html

$9.5 million, about 450 victims, $2,500-$50,000; Anuttama Dasa quote 'On behalf of our entire society, I apologize to these young people.' -> https://www.hinduismtoday.com/hpi/2005/05/26/2005-05-26-iskcon-child-abuse-lawsuit-settled-for-us95-million/

Poison: allegations from c.1997 tapes and later hair tests; GBC investigations 1997 and 2001; GBC Resolution 2000 quote 'there is no evidence at this time to support the allegations of poisoning'; 'swelling is going down'; surgeon McIrvine: renal failure and advanced diabetes; statement April 25 2025 -> https://iskconnews.org/statement-regarding-unfounded-poison-allegations/

GBC March 2000 Women in ISKCON resolution quote 'offer their humble apologies to the women of Srila Prabhupada's society' -> https://iskconnews.org/gbc-statement-reaffirms-vaishnava-respect-for-women/

Gita As It Is: 1968 Macmillan abridged, 1972 complete; 1983 revised BBT edition with many changes, BBT says closer to original manuscript; 1972 edition reprinted from 2001 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagavad-G%C4%ABt%C4%81_As_It_Is
Tomsk: filed June 2011; rejected 28 Dec 2011; appeal upheld 21 March 2012 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bhagavad_Gita_As_It_Is_trial
1966 Happening LP 'Krishna Consciousness' -> https://prabhupada-books.de/hare-krsna-mantra/happening-album.html
Swami in a Strange Land, Joshua Greene 2016 -> https://www.simonandschuster.ca/books/Swami-in-a-Strange-Land/Joshua-Greene/9781608878680
